name: Indecent Wife Hana: Gravure
source:
Hana is a loving and understanding wife who debuted as a swimsuit model when she was young. Her husband, our protagonist, discovers it and gets aroused. Hana decides to tease him by doing a photo shoot with the same photographer.

How far will she take it?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2232830/Indecent_Wife_Hana_Gravure/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
Hana是一位充满爱心、善解人意的妻子，年轻时以泳装模特身份出道。她的丈夫，我们的主角，发现了这一点并感到兴奋。哈娜决定与同一位摄影师一起拍摄照片来取笑他。

她会走多远？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2232830/Indecent_Wife_Hana_Gravure/]Steam[/url]]
